'''Mykon Ora''' was a [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] who accompanied [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Denolm Orr]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]] to investigate a link between the planet and [[Darth Malgus]].<ref name="Mission Abstract">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20211001-0|text=Mission Abstract: Investigate link between Darth Malgus and the planet Elom|int=Mission Abstract: Investigate link between Darth Malgus and the planet Elom}}</ref>
